d:
Enjoy The Beautiful Yeno Moha Lyrical Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Keralida Simha, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music By Satyam.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Evergreen Melody. Enjoy The Nostalgic Charm Of Classic Kannada Music And Sing Along With This Lyrical Video, Presented By MRT Music.
Directed by: Chi Dattaraj
Produced by: P. H. Ramarao
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Saritha, Thoogudeepa Srinivas
Music Director: Chellapilla Satyam
Cinematography: R. Madhusudan
Banner: Sri Rajarajeshwari Film Combines
